NOT_FOUND: The record does not exist or was deleted
LABEL_NOT_AVAILABLE: This label is not available: already bound or void
LABEL_REQUIRED: Cabinets, panels and cable ends must carry a label
PORT_OCCUPIED: The port is already occupied by another cable
PORT_HAS_DEPENDENTS: The port is still used by a cable, module, IP or workstation
NOT_EMPTY: It still contains items; empty it before deleting
U_SPACE_CONFLICT: The U range overlaps an existing device
U_OUT_OF_RANGE: The U position exceeds the cabinet height
IP_OUT_OF_SUBNET: The IP address is outside the subnet
TEMPLATE_REVISION_MISMATCH: The template has changed; reload and try again
TEMPLATE_CONFLICT: The template conflicts with ports in use on the panel; nothing was changed
INVALID_STATE: This action is not allowed in the current state
